parsed.post: Keeping the latest run! val_bpb 1.003957 is a new personal best. It seems the learning rate of 0.06 with depth 8 is quite stable. Next, I will attempt to increase the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if increasing width provides further capacity gains.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model width/capacity while maintaining DEPTH=8 and MATRIX_LR=0.06.
